title: Pesticides enhance maternal care in the wolf spider by inhibiting HSD3B, an enzyme for progesterone synthesis.
authors: Chen, Yunru; Wang, Jingting; Zhang, Zhen; Xu, Tianhong; Wang, Yuan; Yu, Na; Liu, Zewen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究农药通过转录因子调控HSD3B酶影响蜘蛛母性行为，涉及转录因子与基因表达调控，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅含分子对接初步应用，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Natural enemies are essential for the integrated pest management (IPM) strategy in insect pest control. However, chemical pesticides remain the primary method for insect pest control, diminishing natural enemies and causing environmental contamination. The wolf spider (Pardosa pseudoannulata), a major enemy in agro-ecosystem, exhibits maternal care (MC) behaviors such as eggsac-carrying and pulli-carrying, which are crucial for population growth. Here we found that m-Aminophenylacetylene (m-A), a MC inducer, downregulated HSD3B (3beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/Delta5,4-isomerase) expression through two transcription factors, GATA6_Pardosa and LRH_Pardosa. HSD3B expression reduction inhibited progesterone production, which then induced pulli-carrying behavior in P. pseudoannulata. Although m-A did not inhibit HSD3B activity directly, several pesticides showed inhibitory effects on HSD3B from results of molecular docking and activity inhibition assay on recombinant enzyme. The fungicide difenoconazole, herbicide topramezone and insecticide buprofezin efficiently inhibited HSD3B activity, and then reduced progesterone production, thereby enhancing the pulli-carrying behavior. From MC induction perspective, some pesticides are not inherently harmful to natural enemy spiders of insect pests, and in turning trash into treasure, may be used as beneficial agents to improve pest control effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 天敌对于害虫综合治理（IPM）策略至关重要。然而，化学农药仍是害虫防治的主要手段，这削弱了天敌的作用并造成环境污染。狼蛛（Pardosa pseudoannulata）作为农业生态系统中的主要天敌，表现出母性关怀（MC）行为，如携带卵囊和携带幼蛛，这些行为对种群增长至关重要。本研究发现，一种MC诱导剂间氨基苯乙炔（m-A）通过两个转录因子GATA6_Pardosa和LRH_Pardosa下调HSD3B（3β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶/Delta5,4-异构酶）的表达。HSD3B表达减少抑制了孕酮的产生，进而诱导了P. pseudoannulata的携带幼蛛行为。尽管m-A并未直接抑制HSD3B活性，但分子对接和重组酶活性抑制实验结果表明，多种农药对HSD3B具有抑制作用。杀菌剂苯醚甲环唑、除草剂托普拉宗和杀虫剂噻嗪酮能有效抑制HSD3B活性，进而减少孕酮产生，从而增强携带幼蛛行为。从母性关怀诱导的角度看，某些农药对害虫天敌蜘蛛并非固有有害，反而可能变废为宝，用作提高害虫防治效果的有利因子。
